node.title: WCL odd next-boundary square-divisor descent
node.statement: The open WCL slots (ell,w)=(1,5),(2,7) have exact fixed-dimensional classifiers. After a unique common dilation, the locator is F(X)=X A(X^2)-bX^2-1 and the relation exists exactly when G(Y)=Y A(Y)^2-(bY+1)^2 divides Y^N-1, with (deg A,N)=(2,256),(3,512). Each remainder ideal is the unit ideal over Q, so a checked nonzero integer Nullstellensatz certificate restricts all survivors to finitely many characteristics. Neither certificate nor an official exclusion is claimed.
